sloka: वृक्षान्धकारान्निर्गत्य जातक्रोधः स रावणिः।आरुरोह रथं सज्जं पूर्वयुक्तं सराक्षसः ।। ६.८६.१५ ।।
transliteration: vṛkṣāndhakārānnirgatya jātakrodhaḥ sa rāvaṇiḥ।āruroha rathaṁ sajjaṁ pūrvayuktaṁ sarākṣasaḥ ।। 6.86.15 ।।

translations.english: Enraged, Indrajith coming out of the darkness of trees ascended the chariot already yoked and fixed firmly.
